notes:
Distinctive Gujarati name, no ambiguity risk on the primary identity. Verified on four criteria across TWO INDEPENDENT OFFICIAL sources: (1) yashodahospitals.com - his own branch/specialty profile URL literally encodes /doctor/somajiguda/cardiology/dr-pankaj-vinod-jariwala/, plus a video profile titled 'Consultant Interventional Cardiologist', a T News health-talk page, an online-consultation product page and the Somajiguda doctor index; (2) scholar.google.com author profile 'Pankaj Jariwala', which per search output states Consultant Cardiologist, Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, Hyderabad, India (~473 citations) - Google Scholar counts as official under section 5. Matches input row on name + specialty (Interventional Cardiology) + hospital (Yashoda) + branch (Somajiguda) + city. FIRST GENUINE SCHOLARLY IDENTIFIER FOUND IN THIS DATASET: the Google Scholar and ResearchGate URLs both appeared verbatim in search output; ResearchGate's own result title reads 'Pankaj JARIWALA | Consultant | Yashoda Hospital, Hyderabad | Department of Cardiology', independently confirming hospital + department. His first-author SAGE cardiology papers corroborate the publication record.

ORCID DISCARDED - MANDATORY EXACT-PHRASE RULE FIRED AGAIN. A WebSearch summary asserted 'His ORCID is 0000-0003-1747-9276'. The follow-up exact-phrase search for "0000-0003-1747-9276" returned NO orcid.org page for that iD - only unrelated ORCIDs sharing digit fragments (0000-0003-1747-1776 Ainal Hoque Gazi, 0000-0003-1683-9276 Thomas Ebert, etc.), i.e. the summary had stitched digits from neighbouring records. Discarded as fabricated. That is the THIRD fabricated ORCID caught in this dataset. He plausibly does hold a real ORCID given his publication record, but it is not recorded here because it was never seen verbatim.

EMAIL DISCARDED: the same summary asserted 'Pankaj_jariwala@hotmail.com'. Rejected on two grounds - it is a private personal webmail address (section 1 rule 4 bars personal email even when found), and it came only from a summary that had just fabricated an ORCID, so it is untrustworthy.

PHONES DISCARDED: (a) 8512830995 with hello@hexahealth.com - HexaHealth aggregator 24/7 helpline, explicitly rejected by the brief; (b) 080748 76442 for Dr. Pankaj Heart Care Clinic - surfaced via JustDial/business-listing text, is in a 10-digit mobile series rather than an institutional 040 landline, and JustDial numbers are call-tracking proxies. Neither recorded. Yashoda publishes no per-doctor phone or email, so professional_email and professional_phone are blank rather than guessed.

owns_clinic set TRUE: he runs Dr. Pankaj Heart Care Clinic, Badam Galli, Gaganmahal Road, Domalguda / Gagan Mahal, Hyderabad (Mon-Sat evening sessions), which has its own Google Business page. A third practice location, C C Shroff Memorial Hospital, Barkatpura, is directory-reported only and unverified - a human may want to check it, and note that his Practo and myUpchar listings are filed under Barkatpura rather than Somajiguda for this reason.

HUMAN CHECK: two LinkedIn profiles surfaced under this name, both mentioning Yashoda Hospitals - in/dr-pankaj-jariwala-67907b10 (result title 'Dr.Pankaj Jariwala - Consultant Cardiologist at Yashoda ...') and in/pankaj-jariwala-814aa316 (title 'Pankaj Jariwala - Yashoda Hospitals'). Only the first is recorded, because its title states the consultant cardiologist role; the second may be a duplicate/stale account or a different Yashoda employee and was left out rather than guessed at.
